question: Who has been honored with the Icon of Excellence award at the Forbes India Leadership Awards (FILA 2025)?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Jay Shah**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] In News__**

__
 
• **Jay Shah**, Chairman of the **International Cricket Council (ICC)**, has been **honoured with the Icon of Excellence award** at **FILA 2025**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• The **Forbes India Leadership Awards (FILA 2025)** recognized his **exceptional contributions to cricket administration** and his role in **innovation and inclusivity**.
 
• **At 36**, he became the **youngest-ever ICC Chairman**, ensuring **global expansion, financial stability, and progressive reforms** in cricket.
 
• His tenure as **BCCI Secretary** saw the **launch of the Women’s Premier League (WPL), pay parity for cricketers, and NCA modernization**.
 
• The **award ceremony** took place at **Jio World Convention Centre, Mumbai**, where **Harsh Mariwala (Marico Ltd) and KVS Manian (Federal Bank CEO)** presented the award.
 
• The event was attended by **leaders from various industries**, celebrating **excellence in different fields**.
